name: Kumo
summary: Shopify wholesale app from Cloudlift GmbH: unlimited custom pricing rules that apply automatically to named customer groups, CSV import and export of price lists, B2B registration forms with an approval workflow, and prices that update in the theme without code edits. Built for Shopify, launched November 2024.
best_for: Shopify merchants on a standard plan who need wholesale prices for named customer groups, with CSV price lists and a registration form that someone approves, and who would rather not pay three times as much for a heavier wholesale app
skip_if: you are already on Shopify Plus, where company accounts and price lists come with the platform; or you want prices that react to competitors or to the market, because this sets fixed rules per customer group and nothing reads the outside world
honest_knock:
Five stars over nine reviews is not a track record, and the age makes that worse rather than better. The app launched on 21 November 2024, so it has had close to two years on the App Store to collect them. Nine reviews in that window is a small installed base, and a small installed base is what decides whether an app is still maintained in 2028: the rating tells you the nine are happy, not that the app is safe to build a wholesale channel on.

The second plan is a trap for anyone who reads the ladder as a feature ladder. PLUS costs twice B2B and the three things it adds (company registration, catalog assignment, checkout integration) are all labelled Shopify Plus on the listing itself. On a standard Shopify plan the extra $15 a month buys nothing you can switch on.

pricing.entry_price_terms: B2B · per month with unlimited pricing rules
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-16 on apps.shopify.com/b2b-wholesale-tools; re-verified 2026-10-19, unchanged) Two plans and no free tier: B2B at $15 a month and PLUS at $30, both with a 7-day free trial, billed in USD every 30 days. B2B carries the whole working app — wholesale pricing, volume pricing, customer registration forms and the approval workflow — and pricing rules are unlimited rather than metered, so the ladder is not a volume ladder. PLUS adds exactly three things, and all three are Shopify Plus features: company registration, product catalog assignment and checkout integration. If you are not on Shopify Plus, the $30 tier has nothing to sell you. The app is Built for Shopify, launched on 21 November 2024, and shows 5.0 stars over 9 reviews.

schema_offer.description: B2B, per month with unlimited pricing rules; the $30 PLUS tier only adds features that require Shopify Plus. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-19.

compare_with.name: Wholesale Gorilla
compare_with.why: Same job, very different bill. Wholesale Gorilla runs $34.95, $69.95 and $149.95 a month against Kumo's $15 and $30, and buys you a nine-year history and 313 reviews against Kumo's nine. That is the whole trade: Gorilla is the safer bet on longevity and the deeper app, Kumo is less than half the entry price with unlimited pricing rules and a 7-day trial instead of Gorilla's 21-day one. On a standard Shopify plan with a handful of wholesale groups, Kumo does the job for the price of Gorilla's trial period.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Kumo (B2B Wholesale Tools) on a Shopify development store: the install, a 20 percent price rule for customers with a tag, the preview price, the Plans page with greyed out Select buttons and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was saved in the theme and nothing was paid. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Kumo B2B Wholesale Tools, from Cloudlift, and says From $15/month. Free trial available., with a rating of 5.0 from 9 reviews and a launch date of 21 November 2024; it names B2B at $15 a month and PLUS at $30 a month, both with a 7-day free trial, and says all charges are billed in USD, with recurring and usage based charges every 30 days. Install was clicked at about 11:52 and asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, discounts, Shopify Functions, Online Store, Shopify admin). The app, called B2B Wholesale Tools in the admin, opened straight on Home with no plan screen and no Approve subscription screen. Home showed a Setup Guide at 0 / 3 completed (Enable the app, Setup your first price config, Test pricing on your store), App not enabled with a button Enable App in theme editor, and an onboarding call with Book a call, which we did not use. Core action: Setup pricing, Create pricing. We named the rule Wholesale 20 percent, type Percentage, discount 20, customer conditions Targets customers with specific tags with the tag wholesale, product conditions Applies to all products, status Active. Save gave Config saved and the rule showed as Active; the Message field filled itself with WHOLESALE_20_PERCENT. Preview product with Bundle Product #1, which the product picker lists at $1,382.31, showed $ 1,105.60 in the app. A 20 percent discount on $1,382.31 is $1,105.85, so the app preview is 25 cents lower than that; we did not find out why. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 2 minutes from the install click at about 11:52:57 to the preview price at about 11:54:58, in about 10 steps. The theme editor was not used and nothing was saved in the theme; the app was not enabled in the theme, so the price was not seen in the store preview and no customer with the tag wholesale was tried. The menu also has Add Volume pricing, Add Bulk ordering, Add Minimum quantity, Forms, Submissions, Checkout and Price lists; these were not tested. Plans: the Plans page said Your current plan: DEVELOPER and You are on a development store! You are on a unlimited trail plan until this store goes live. B2B $15 a month lists Wholesale pricing, Volume pricing, Registration forms and Approval workflow; PLUS $30 a month lists All of B2B features, Product catalog assignment and Shopify plus checkout integration. The PLUS card shows two Plus features in the app, while the listing names three, including company registration. Both Select buttons were greyed out, so no Shopify approval screen was reached and nothing could be approved. Cancelling: there was no subscription to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, Uninstall; the dialog says that you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A Reason for uninstalling is required (we chose Testing multiple apps) and feedback is optional. Not tested: a real customer with the tag wholesale in the store, volume pricing, the registration form, the approval workflow, CSV price lists, the checkout settings, the Plus features, any paid plan and the trial. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 11:56 and Shopify confirmed it; the plan and its discounts went with it. Nothing was saved in the theme. Our own tabs were closed, except one tab opened by the install button that could not be closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app preview price is 25 cents lower than a plain 20 percent of the listed price, the Select buttons are greyed out on a development store, and the price rule is only seen in the store after the app is enabled in the theme.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Kumo (B2B Wholesale Tools) on a Shopify development store: the install, a 20 percent price rule for customers with a tag, the preview price, the Plans page with greyed out Select buttons and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was saved in the theme and nothing was paid. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Kumo B2B Wholesale Tools, from Cloudlift, and says From $15/month. Free trial available., with a rating of 5.0 from 9 reviews and a launch date of 21 November 2024; it names B2B at $15 a month and PLUS at $30 a month, both with a 7-day free trial, and says all charges are billed in USD, with recurring and usage based charges every 30 days. Install was clicked at about 11:52 and asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, discounts, Shopify Functions, Online Store, Shopify admin). The app, called B2B Wholesale Tools in the admin, opened straight on Home with no plan screen and no Approve subscription screen. Home showed a Setup Guide at 0 / 3 completed (Enable the app, Setup your first price config, Test pricing on your store), App not enabled with a button Enable App in theme editor, and an onboarding call with Book a call, which we did not use. Core action: Setup pricing, Create pricing. We named the rule Wholesale 20 percent, type Percentage, discount 20, customer conditions Targets customers with specific tags with the tag wholesale, product conditions Applies to all products, status Active. Save gave Config saved and the rule showed as Active; the Message field filled itself with WHOLESALE_20_PERCENT. Preview product with Bundle Product #1, which the product picker lists at $1,382.31, showed $ 1,105.60 in the app. A 20 percent discount on $1,382.31 is $1,105.85, so the app preview is 25 cents lower than that; we did not find out why. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 2 minutes from the install click at about 11:52:57 to the preview price at about 11:54:58, in about 10 steps. The theme editor was not used and nothing was saved in the theme; the app was not enabled in the theme, so the price was not seen in the store preview and no customer with the tag wholesale was tried. The menu also has Add Volume pricing, Add Bulk ordering, Add Minimum quantity, Forms, Submissions, Checkout and Price lists; these were not tested. Plans: the Plans page said Your current plan: DEVELOPER and You are on a development store! You are on a unlimited trail plan until this store goes live. B2B $15 a month lists Wholesale pricing, Volume pricing, Registration forms and Approval workflow; PLUS $30 a month lists All of B2B features, Product catalog assignment and Shopify plus checkout integration. The PLUS card shows two Plus features in the app, while the listing names three, including company registration. Both Select buttons were greyed out, so no Shopify approval screen was reached and nothing could be approved. Cancelling: there was no subscription to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, Uninstall; the dialog says that you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A Reason for uninstalling is required (we chose Testing multiple apps) and feedback is optional. Not tested: a real customer with the tag wholesale in the store, volume pricing, the registration form, the approval workflow, CSV price lists, the checkout settings, the Plus features, any paid plan and the trial. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 11:56 and Shopify confirmed it; the plan and its discounts went with it. Nothing was saved in the theme. Our own tabs were closed, except one tab opened by the install button that could not be closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app preview price is 25 cents lower than a plain 20 percent of the listed price, the Select buttons are greyed out on a development store, and the price rule is only seen in the store after the app is enabled in the theme.
